gpu.title: Turnip GPU Drivers
gpu.subtitle: Open-source Adreno Vulkan drivers — the heart of Android PC gaming
gpu.what_body: Turnip is an open-source Mesa Vulkan driver for Qualcomm Adreno GPUs. It enables much better Vulkan performance than stock drivers.
gpu.a8xx_body: The featured driver below automatically fetches the latest Gen8 ZIP from StevenMXZ/Adreno-Tools-Drivers — always get the newest experimental Turnip build for Snapdragon 8 Elite / 8s Elite.
winlator.title: Winlator Builds & Mods
winlator.subtitle: Run Windows x86/x64 games on your Android device
winlator.intro_body: is a free Android app that lets you run Windows software using Box64 + Wine. Different community mods offer better compatibility, performance tweaks, and extra features.
tools.title: GameHub Builds & More
tools.subtitle: Launchers, translation layers and emulation cores
guide.title: Quick-Start Guide
guide.subtitle: Get Windows games running in 5 steps
guide.step1_body: Go to Settings → About phone and note your SoC model (e.g. Snapdragon 8 Elite). Match it to the compatibility table above — A8xx users get the latest Turnip ZIP automatically.
guide.step2_body: Grab the Winlator APK of your choice below, and for A8xx devices use the featured driver button that directly fetches the newest .zip from GitHub.
guide.step3_body: Install the APK, open Winlator, go to Settings → GPU Driver, tap Import, and select the downloaded Turnip .zip. Then set it as the active driver.
guide.step4_body: Create a new container. Under Graphics, select Turnip as renderer and enable DXVK. For DX12 games, also enable VKD3D-Proton in the container settings.
guide.step5_body: Tap Add Shortcut, browse to your game's .exe, assign it to the container, and hit Start. Use GameHub for a clean front-end experience with cover art.

card.driver_a8xx.name: Turnip for Snapdragon 8 Elite / 8s Elite (A8xx)
card.driver_a8xx.description: Latest experimental Turnip Vulkan driver for Adreno 830/840. Direct .zip download — always up-to-date with the newest Gen8 release from StevenMXZ/Adreno-Tools-Drivers. Enables Vulkan 1.3, ray-tracing, and major performance gains in Winlator.
card.winlator_official.name: Winlator Official
card.winlator_official.description: The original Winlator by brunodev85. Solid base for running Windows games with Box64 and Wine 9.x on ARM Android.
card.winlator_cmod.name: Winlator Cmod
card.winlator_cmod.description: Community mod with extra performance profiles, updated Box64 dynarec, and improved Turnip integration.
card.winlator_ludashi.name: Winlator Ludashi
card.winlator_ludashi.description: Winlator fork with Arm64EC containers using FEXCore and optional WowBox64, enhancing 32-bit compatibility.
card.gamehub.name: GameHub
card.gamehub.description: Unified game launcher for Winlator. Displays installed games with cover art, per-game Turnip drivers and DXVK presets.
card.gamenative.name: GameNative
card.gamenative.description: Play games you own on Steam, Epic and GOG directly on Android devices, with cloud saves.
card.bannerhub.name: BannerHub (Revanced)

card.vkd3d.name: VKD3D-Proton
card.vkd3d.description: Translates DirectX 12 to Vulkan. Essential for DX12 games in Winlator.
card.dxvk.name: DXVK
card.dxvk.description: Translates DirectX 9/10/11 to Vulkan. Critical for most PC games in Winlator.
card.box64.name: Box64
card.box64.description: ARM64 x86_64 emulator/translator. The core engine that makes Winlator work.
card.fexcore.name: FexCore
card.fexcore.description: Prioritizes accuracy. On modern setups it can give you very good compatibility without too much fuss.
